comment: USD per million tokens, Anthropic first-party API list prices (claude-api reference, cached 2026-06-24). Claude Code subscriptions bill differently; the report uses these as a common yardstick. cache_write = 5-minute cache writes (1.25x input); 1-hour writes are priced at 2x input. Longest matching prefix of the model id wins.

tiers.comment: Model used to reprice a spawn at another tier (counterfactuals). Match what your Claude Code resolves these aliases to.
